# Orion Residence, Bukit Bintang KL

> Marketing site for Orion Residence, a freehold 46-storey branded residence on Jalan Gading, Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur, developed by Orion Tower Sdn. Bhd. (Welton Group of Companies). Managed by Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305), IQI Realty Sdn Bhd. Not the developer's official website.

## Project facts
- Name: Orion Residence
- Address: Jalan Gading, Bukit Bintang, 55100 Kuala Lumpur
- Tenure: Freehold; land 0.56 acres
- Developer: Orion Tower Sdn. Bhd. (Welton Group of Companies)
- Building: 46 storeys, 298 residences; Level 11-31: 10 units; Level 32-39: 9 units
- Unit sizes: 491 – 1329 sq ft, studios to 2-bedroom, terrace and dual-key options; fully furnished with designer-brand appliances (Gaggenau, Miele, Bosch, Kohler)
- Starting price: from RM 1.58 million (current price list on request)
- Maintenance: RM 1.32 psf (RM 1.20 psf + 10% sinking fund)
- Status: Under Construction; completion 2025 per the developer's materials
- Highlights: Bukit Bintang golden address; Limelight facade with moire effect; automated concierge parking; private security vault service by a Swiss security firm; 5-star hospitality services; rooftop Sky Lounge, Moon Bar and fine dining with panoramic city views; infinity pool
- Facility zones: The Galactic | The Aquarius | The Cosmos | The Aurora | The Constellation

## 中文简介
Orion Residence 位于吉隆坡武吉免登 Jalan Gading，永久地契，46 层 298 户品牌服务式住宅，发展商 Orion Tower Sdn. Bhd. (Welton Group of Companies)。单位 491 至 1,329 平方尺，全装修，起价 RM 1.58 million，配备屋顶 Sky Lounge、Moon Bar、无边泳池及五星酒店式服务。联系人：Yee Woei Shyan（REN 46305，IQI Realty），WhatsApp +60 10-827 8932。
